exposure: soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1/placental growth factor (sFlt-1/PlGF) ratio
ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM) parameters (daytime BP, nighttime BP, non-dipper, riser, dipper types)
cohort: The study included 476 participants suspected of preeclampsia between 28 + 0 and 33 + 6 weeks gestation.
finding: The sFlt-1/PlGF ratio was positively correlated with BP parameters and increased non-dipper type changes in ABPM, and combining sFlt-1/PlGF with ABPM (specifically nighttime DBP) improved prediction of preeclampsia.
